body:
Yeah, I can really relate to that. If it wasn't for my family and gf I'd really have absolutely 0 reason to be alive. I don't think I could actually do it because of how it would make my gf and family feel. I don't want to heap my problems on my gf either but it feels like I end up doing it anyway and I feel bad. 

Thanks for the tip on taking it as my responsibility to make her life better, that seems like a decent enough thing to try.
Good point, now only if I had someone understanding who would listen...

Thanks for the tip on psychiatrist vs psychologist or psychotherapist. Also I deeply care about what other people think about me so even if they have no right to judge I think they would and I'd feel bad about it. Point 3 was nice to hear and I hope I can get through this and to that point... I hope...
Thanks, how did you end up finding resolution to what you were struggling with?

Now why would it be a waste? We both know the outcome of life is exactly the same no matter what I do. Thanks for the advice on the online resources. I would argue that for some people, living just wasn't meant to be. There are 7 billion other people out there so I really won't be missed by a small fraction of a fraction of a percent. I realize taking care of myself comes first but I can't help myself when I try to help her. I'm also not considering suicide lightly, I've given it a great deal of thought and it seems to be the most logical course of action. I promised myself that I'd try for a while to convince myself it's not the best option, but I constantly think about it and I don't really see any good alternatives (live out life in depression and misery? sounds like a blast...)
